**Mission:** Create a systematic, data-driven map of the AI safety ecosystem to identify neglected areas and guide resource allocation.

**Why This:** It addresses a genuine gap—knowledge about "who's working on what" is currently tribal and informal. This leads to duplication in popular areas while important work stays neglected. A comprehensive database will help funders, researchers, and career-changers make better decisions.

**Why This Works for You:**
- Fits your constraints (can work part-time, doesn't require you to be publicly prominent initially)
- Leverages your skills (Python, writing) + Priya's data analysis expertise
- Genuinely needed and currently neglected
- Fundable and sustainable
- Creates a permanent public good
